card.name: Inside words starting with Ret
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the piece right after or at the start of a word beginning with "ret", such as retinoids, retinal, retinopathy, retinitis and reticulocyte. It is strongest on the second piece (ic, in, init) after "ret".
